name: Claude subscription
purpose: Claude for building (Claude Code) and for in-app text features through the Claude API.

tasks.title: Confirm the team plan and seats
steps: Check the build team has Claude seats with Claude Code access
Create a separate Console workspace and API key per client build
tasks.doneWhen: Each build has its own key and usage is tracked separately.

tasks.title: Set spend limits and keep the key server-side
steps: Set a monthly spend limit on the workspace
Call the API only from server routes; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is never shipped to the browser
tasks.doneWhen: Limit is set; the client bundle contains no key.

tasks.title: Pin the model in config
steps: Read the model ID from an env var (e.g. CRIS_MODEL) with a current default
Document the chosen model in the client manifest
tasks.doneWhen: Changing the model needs no code change.

tasks.title: Build a graceful fallback
steps: If the key is missing or the API errors, the feature degrades without breaking the page
AI stays an assistant, never the primary interface

tasks.title: Check prompts and outputs before release
steps: Run a fixed set of sample prompts and compare against expected answers
Confirm no personal data is sent in prompts or logged

tasks.title: Monthly usage and model review
steps: Review spend per build against the limit
Check for newer models and plan upgrades
